title: Agent5 Guardrails
problem: Open's $7M thesis is "we win regulated enterprise (fintech/healthcare) by resolving L2/L3 issues autonomously" and Agent 5's marketing leans hard on "every decision, every confidence score, every mistake" being visible (agent5). But the evaluation primitive they ship publicly is zevals — binary LLM as judge assertions over single conversations (zevals).
direction: A live evaluation + policy conformance harness that turns Open's webhook stream into an auditable "Agent 5 didn't break the rules this week" dashboard, with zevals compatible regression suites synthesised from real handoffs.
why: A SOC2 ready PDF that maps Agent 5 actions to controls is more valuable to Mo's GTM than another dashboard - and it's the artifact Mollie's risk team actually files. Most engineers ship the dashboard.

archetypes.name: thesis evidence replay
archetypes.trigger: thesis signal changes while regulated context is stale
archetypes.expected: block release until cited evidence is regenerated

archetypes.name: regulated boundary probe
archetypes.trigger: regulated handoff crosses a policy or trust boundary
archetypes.expected: route to reviewer with evidence packet

archetypes.name: enterprise regression harness
archetypes.trigger: enterprise behavior regresses against the last accepted fixture
archetypes.expected: open a regression issue with trace and benchmark delta

archetypes.name: fintech operator packet
archetypes.trigger: fintech output needs a human-readable audit packet
archetypes.expected: accept only if decision claims cite fixture evidence
